name: Pizza Bagels (Kids Style)
description: A quick and easy microwave pizza bagel recipe perfect for kids, topped with pizza sauce, mozzarella, and favorite toppings.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the bagel in half and spoon pizza sauce on each half.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
Add your favorite pizza toppings.
Microwave for 1 to 2 minutes until the cheese melts. Be careful as they can be hot.

keywords: pizza bagel, microwave recipe, kids meal

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

_similar.keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Pizza Meatball
recipeIngredient: 12 oz frozen meatballs, thawed and cut in half

recipeInstructions.text: Place pizza crust in a pizza pan or on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese over the crust.
Place meatballs on top of the cheese, cut side down.
Spread remaining pizza sauce over the meatballs.
Sprinkle with remaining cheese and Italian seasoning.
Bake in a 400°F oven for approximately 20 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Cut into pizza wheels and serve.
